# Lawn Advisor
> A free lawn analysis tool by Chris Izworski: enter a US address and get a graded, climate-zone-correct lawn plan with a seasonal task calendar.

Plans are built from verified zone and climate facts for the address, with shareable links and an iCal export of the task schedule.

## Key pages
- [Lawn analyzer](https://lawn.chrisizworski.com/): enter an address for a graded plan
- [Articles](https://lawn.chrisizworski.com/articles): cornerstone lawn care guides
- [Michigan city guides](https://lawn.chrisizworski.com/lawn-guide/michigan): 28 city-specific lawn guides
- [Shop](https://lawn.chrisizworski.com/shop): recommended products

## Author
Chris Izworski (https://chrisizworski.com), Michigan gardener and outdoor writer. Related: Freighter View Farms (https://freighterviewfarms.com), Michigan Phenology (https://phenology.chrisizworski.com).
